text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

No problem at all. Sofa cleaning is three hundred forty nine rupees per seat with a minimum of 3 seats, and kitchen cleaning is one thousand five hundred ninety nine rupees total. We work Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Would you like me to note this interest for our team to review next month?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?

Our working hours are Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Since you are interested for next month, would you like me to note an enquiry for team review now? Please note, an enquiry is not a confirmed slot or paid order.
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
